## What's new

- 🔲 **Lane layout**: rules that overlap in time are now shown side by side in the weekly card instead of stacking on top of each other. Each overlapping block gets its own lane and the width is split between the lanes in use; a chain of partial overlaps reuses free lanes, and blocks that merely touch keep the full width. Works with overnight and multi-day slots and with the "pending" blocks shown while saving.
- 🗺 README roadmap updated: next up are export/import of rules and an optional validity period, followed by optional execution conditions, optional notifications, non-weekly recurrence and one-off exceptions.

Full changelog from the beta channel: v1.5.0-beta1.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0
